newsitem.title: USA: Charter buys telephone card developer.
newsitem.headline: Charter buys telephone card developer.

text.p: Charter Communications International Inc said on Wednesday it acquired LatCom International, which develops and markets the VisTel telephone debit card, oriented towards Hispanics.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company said LatCom would manage its marketing of the VisTel debit card in the domestic Hispanic sector and throughout Latin America.
Charter Communications subsidiary Overlook Communications International Corp is the long distance carrier of the VisTel card, the company said.
